label: Dependent of a Yale member

coverage.statement: Dependents enroll through the member's plan by the enrollment deadline, and can get hospitalization/specialty coverage through Yale Health. Anything beyond that goes to Member Services at (203) 432-0246.
coverage.source: Yale Health Enrollment and Eligibility page (dependents of students enroll in the student's plan by the enrollment deadline)
